+def find_author_by_remote_ids(remote_ids: dict[str, str]) -> "Author | None":
+    """Find the most consistently identified author, with a stable key tie-break."""

 class Author(Thing):
     """Class to represent /type/author objects in OL."""
 
+    def merge_remote_ids(self, incoming_ids: dict[str, str]) -> tuple[dict[str, str], int]:
+        """Merge incoming external identifiers, rejecting conflicting values.
+
+        The returned count is the number of incoming identifiers already present
+        with the same value.
+        """
+        existing_ids = dict(self.get('remote_ids') or {})
+        conflicts = {
+            identifier: (existing_ids[identifier], value)
+            for identifier, value in incoming_ids.items()
+            if identifier in existing_ids and existing_ids[identifier] != value
+        }
+        if conflicts:
+            details = ", ".join(
+                f"{identifier}: existing {existing!r}, incoming {incoming!r}"
+                for identifier, (existing, incoming) in sorted(conflicts.items())
+            )
+            raise AuthorRemoteIdConflictError(
+                f"Conflicting remote IDs for author {self.key}: {details}"
+            )
+
+        matches = sum(
+            identifier in existing_ids and existing_ids[identifier] == value
+            for identifier, value in incoming_ids.items()
+        )
+        return {**existing_ids, **incoming_ids}, matches
